Now, about the GameScene changes: on P key press, toggle pause, zero out velocity and skip the movement handler while paused, and display "PAUSED" text in the center.

The existing pattern uses `this.input.keyboard.createCursorKeys()`; for P, add a key handler in `create()` with `this.input.keyboard.on('keydown-P', ...)`. This is idiomatic Phaser and the simplest approach.

Also, when paused, update() should be skipped entirely (freeze movement). Physics bodies retain velocity, so set velocity to 0 when entering pause.

PAUSED text: `this.add.text(400, 300, 'PAUSED', {...}).setOrigin(0.5)` — center of the 800x600 game. Toggle visibility on/off.
